items.title: Negative Adverbial Inversion
items.nativeTitle: Not only / Seldom / Rarely + Auxiliary + Subject
items.formula: Negative Adverb (Rarely / Seldom / Never / Not only) + Aux + S + V
items.explanationId: Ketika keterangan bermakna negatif atau pembatas diletakkan di awal kalimat untuk penekanan, susunan subjek dan kata kerja bantu (auxiliary) wajib dibalik (inversi) seperti kalimat tanya.
items.keyTip: Pola jebakan paling sering di TOEFL ITP Structure! Cari 'does/did/has/can/will' tepat setelah frasa negatif di awal kalimat.

examples.sentence: Rarely have marine biologists observed this species near the surface.
examples.translationId: Jarang sekali ahli biologi laut mengamati spesies ini di dekat permukaan.

examples.sentence: Not only did the team finish ahead of schedule, but they also reduced costs.
examples.translationId: Tim tidak hanya selesai lebih cepat dari jadwal, tetapi juga menekan biaya.

quiz.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct completion (TOEFL ITP Structure):
quiz.sentence: Not until the late nineteenth century ______ widely used in urban street lighting.
quiz.explanationId: 'Not until...' di awal kalimat mewajibkan inversi pada klausa utama: auxiliary 'did' + subjek 'electricity' + V1 'become'.

items.title: Subject-Verb Agreement with Prepositional Phrases
items.formula: Head Noun + [of / with / along with / as well as + Object] + Verb (matches Head Noun)
items.explanationId: Kata kerja (verb) selalu mengikuti kata benda utama (head noun), bukan kata benda yang berada di dalam frasa preposisi seperti 'of the students', 'along with', atau 'together with'.
items.keyTip: Coret mental frasa yang diawali 'of', 'in', 'with', 'along with', atau 'as well as' untuk menemukan subjek sejati.

examples.sentence: The collection of rare manuscripts is housed in the central archive.
examples.translationId: Koleksi naskah langka itu disimpan di arsip pusat.

examples.sentence: The project director, along with two engineers, attends every safety audit.
examples.translationId: Direktur proyek, bersama dua insinyur, menghadiri setiap audit keselamatan.

quiz.prompt: Select the correct verb form:
quiz.sentence: The discovery of several well-preserved fossils in the desert ______ reshaped evolutionary timelines.
quiz.explanationId: Subjek utamanya adalah 'The discovery' (tunggal), bukan 'fossils', sehingga membutuhkan auxiliary tunggal 'has'.

items.title: Parallel Structure (Correlative Conjunctions)
items.formula: Element A (Noun / Gerund / Adj / Infinitive) + Conjunction + Element B (same grammatical form)
items.explanationId: Unsur yang dihubungkan oleh kata sambung setara (and, or, but, both...and, neither...nor, not only...but also) harus memiliki kelas kata atau struktur gramatikal yang sejajar.
items.keyTip: Jika sebelum 'and' berupa gerund (-ing) atau kata sifat, maka setelah 'and' juga harus dalam bentuk yang sama.

examples.sentence: Effective leadership requires clear communication, decisive action, and ethical judgment.
examples.translationId: Kepemimpinan efektif menuntut komunikasi jelas, tindakan tegas, dan pertimbangan etis.

examples.sentence: The software is designed both to monitor energy use and to predict equipment failure.
examples.translationId: Perangkat lunak ini dirancang baik untuk memantau penggunaan energi maupun memprediksi kerusakan alat.

quiz.prompt: Identify the underlined segment that contains a grammatical error (TOEFL Written Expression):
quiz.sentence: The workshop aims [A] to strengthen analytical reading, [B] to expand academic vocabulary, and [C] writing persuasive essays [D] under timed conditions.
quiz.explanationId: Dua unsur pertama memakai to-infinitive ('to strengthen', 'to expand'), sehingga unsur ketiga harus sejajar: 'to write persuasive essays'.

items.title: Reduced Relative Clauses (Participle Modifiers)
items.formula: Noun + V-ing (aktif: yang melakukan) | Noun + V3 (pasif: yang dikenai)
items.explanationId: Klausa relatif ('which is located', 'who submitted') sering dipersingkat menjadi frasa partisipel. Gunakan V-ing jika maknanya aktif dan V3 jika maknanya pasif, dan pastikan kalimat tetap memiliki satu kata kerja utama.
items.keyTip: Jangan tertipu memilih V2/verb utama kedua jika kalimat sudah punya kata kerja utama (main verb).

examples.sentence: Applications submitted after the Friday deadline will not be considered.
examples.translationId: Lamaran yang dikirim setelah tenggat Jumat tidak akan dipertimbangkan.

examples.sentence: Researchers analyzing Arctic ice cores detected elevated methane levels.
examples.translationId: Peneliti yang menganalisis inti es Arktik mendeteksi kadar metana yang meningkat.

quiz.prompt: Choose the correct reduced clause:
quiz.sentence: The solar observatory ______ atop the mountain provides unobstructed views of the southern sky.
quiz.explanationId: Kalimat sudah memiliki main verb 'provides'. 'Located' (bentuk ringkas dari 'which is located') bertindak sebagai modifier pasif.

items.title: Appositives & Non-Restrictive Modifiers
items.formula: Subject, [Noun Phrase explaining Subject], Main Verb
items.explanationId: Appositive adalah frasa kata benda yang diapit tanda koma untuk menjelaskan subjek tanpa kata kerja utama sendiri. Appositive dapat berada di awal kalimat atau tepat setelah subjek.
items.keyTip: Appositive tidak boleh mengandung subjek+predikat lengkap kecuali memakai klausa relatif ('who/which').

examples.sentence: A pioneer in modern radiology, Marie Curie won Nobel Prizes in two distinct sciences.
examples.translationId: Sebagai pelopor radiologi modern, Marie Curie meraih Hadiah Nobel di dua bidang sains berbeda.

examples.sentence: Batik, a traditional wax-resist dyeing technique, was recognized by UNESCO in 2009.
examples.translationId: Batik, teknik pewarnaan rintang lilin tradisional, diakui UNESCO pada tahun 2009.

quiz.prompt: Choose the correct appositive phrase:
quiz.sentence: ______, the mangrove forest acts as a natural buffer against coastal erosion.
choices: It is a dense coastal ecosystem
That is a dense coastal ecosystem
quiz.explanationId: 'A dense coastal ecosystem' adalah appositive frasa benda yang tepat menjelaskan subjek 'the mangrove forest'.

items.title: Subjunctive Mood (Mandative)
items.nativeTitle: recommend / insist / essential that + S + V1
items.formula: Verb/Adj of urgency (recommend, require, insist, vital) + that + Subject + Base Verb (V1 / be)
items.explanationId: Setelah kata kerja atau kata sifat yang menyatakan keharusan/saran (recommend, suggest, demand, essential, imperative) diikuti 'that', kata kerja berikutnya selalu berbentuk dasar (bare infinitive) tanpa '-s' dan tanpa 'is/was'.
items.keyTip: Mesin soal TOEFL & TOEIC suka menguji 'be' atau V1 tanpa '-s' setelah subjek tunggal seperti 'he/she/the report'.

examples.sentence: The committee recommended that every applicant submit two reference letters.
examples.translationId: Komite merekomendasikan agar setiap pelamar menyerahkan dua surat referensi.

examples.sentence: It is imperative that the laboratory equipment be calibrated weekly.
examples.translationId: Sangat penting agar peralatan laboratorium dikalibrasi setiap minggu.

quiz.prompt: Complete the formal recommendation:
quiz.sentence: The safety auditor insisted that the emergency exit ______ unobstructed at all times.
quiz.explanationId: Setelah 'insisted that', bentuk subjunctive wajib memakai kata kerja dasar 'remain' (tanpa -s).

items.title: Despite / In Spite Of vs. Although / Even Though
items.formula: Despite / In spite of + Noun/V-ing  ||  Although / Even though + Subject + Verb
items.explanationId: 'Despite' dan 'in spite of' adalah preposisi sehingga hanya boleh diikuti kata benda atau gerund (-ing). Sebaliknya, 'although', 'though', dan 'even though' adalah konjungsi yang wajib diikuti subjek dan kata kerja.
items.keyTip: Ingat: tidak pernah ada frasa 'despite of'! Jika setelah rumpang ada Subject + Verb, pilih 'although/even though'.

examples.sentence: Despite the unexpected flight delay, the delegation arrived in time for the keynote.
examples.translationId: Meskipun terjadi penundaan penerbangan tak terduga, delegasi tiba tepat waktu untuk pidato utama.

examples.sentence: Although fuel costs rose sharply, the airline maintained its regional fares.
examples.translationId: Walaupun biaya bahan bakar naik tajam, maskapai tetap mempertahankan tarif regionalnya.

quiz.prompt: Choose the correct connector (TOEIC Part 5):
quiz.sentence: ______ rising raw material prices, quarterly revenue exceeded our initial forecast.
quiz.explanationId: 'Rising raw material prices' adalah frasa kata benda (tanpa main verb), sehingga wajib memakai preposisi 'Despite'.

items.title: Conditional Inversion (Had / Were / Should)
items.formula: Should + S + V1 (Type 1) | Were + S + to V1 (Type 2) | Had + S + V3 (Type 3)
items.explanationId: Dalam bahasa bisnis formal (TOEIC) dan tulisan akademik (IELTS/TOEFL), kata 'if' pada kalimat pengandaian dapat dihilangkan dengan memindahkan 'Should', 'Were', atau 'Had' ke depan subjek.
items.keyTip: Dalam email bisnis TOEIC, 'Should you have any questions...' sama artinya dengan 'If you have any questions...'.

examples.sentence: Should you require technical assistance, please contact our help desk.
examples.translationId: Jika Anda memerlukan bantuan teknis, silakan hubungi layanan bantuan kami.

examples.sentence: Had the engineers detected the leak earlier, the shutdown could have been avoided.
examples.translationId: Seandainya para insinyur mendeteksi kebocoran lebih awal, penghentian operasi bisa dihindari.

quiz.prompt: Select the formal conditional opening (TOEIC Part 5):
quiz.sentence: ______ you need to reschedule your appointment, kindly notify reception 24 hours in advance.
quiz.explanationId: 'Should you need...' adalah inversi formal untuk 'If you should need...' yang sangat lazim pada surat bisnis.

items.title: Word Form Selection (Parts of Speech)
items.formula: Adv + Adj + Noun  |  Verb + Adv  |  Prep + Noun/Gerund
items.explanationId: Sekitar 30% soal TOEIC Part 5 menguji ketepatan kelas kata dari satu akar kata yang sama (mis. rely, reliable, reliably, reliability). Analisis posisi kata sebelum dan sesudah rumpang.
items.keyTip: Lihat kata tepat sebelum rumpang: artikel 'a/an/the' + adj menuntut Noun; sebelum Adjective atau memodifikasi Verb biasanya butuh Adverb (-ly).

examples.sentence: The newly renovated branch operates remarkably efficiently during peak hours.
examples.translationId: Cabang yang baru direnovasi beroperasi sangat efisien selama jam sibuk.

examples.sentence: Customer satisfaction depends heavily on the reliability of delivery schedules.
examples.translationId: Kepuasan pelanggan sangat bergantung pada keandalan jadwal pengiriman.

quiz.prompt: Choose the correct word form (TOEIC Part 5):
quiz.sentence: Ms. Tan received praise for managing the regional product launch ______.
quiz.explanationId: Rumpang memodifikasi cara melakukan kata kerja 'managing', sehingga membutuhkan adverb 'efficiently'.

items.title: Double Comparatives (The more..., the more...)
items.formula: The + Comparative (+ S + V), the + Comparative (+ S + V)
items.explanationId: Struktur 'The + comparative..., the + comparative...' menunjukkan hubungan sebab-akibat berbanding lurus atau terbalik. Kedua klausa wajib diawali kata sandang 'the' diikuti bentuk komparatif.
items.keyTip: Periksa kelengkapan 'the' dan bentuk komparatif (-er / more / less) di kedua sisi koma.

examples.sentence: The higher the altitude, the lower the atmospheric pressure becomes.
examples.translationId: Semakin tinggi ketinggian, semakin rendah tekanan atmosfernya.

examples.sentence: The more thoroughly students prepare, the more confident they feel during exams.
examples.translationId: Semakin matang siswa mempersiapkan diri, semakin percaya diri mereka saat ujian.

quiz.prompt: Complete the proportional statement:
quiz.sentence: The earlier a language learner begins daily listening practice, ______ their auditory recognition improves.
quiz.explanationId: Pasangan wajib untuk 'The earlier...' adalah 'the + comparative' yaitu 'the faster'.

items.title: By the Time + Past/Future Perfect
items.formula: By the time + S + V1 (present) -> S + will have + V3  ||  By the time + S + V2 (past) -> S + had + V3
items.explanationId: Penanda waktu 'By the time' atau 'By + waktu masa depan/lampau' menekankan bahwa suatu peristiwa sudah selesai sebelum titik waktu lainnya terjadi, sehingga berpasangan dengan Perfect Tense.
items.keyTip: Jika klausa 'by the time' memakai Present Simple (mis. 'arrives'), klausa utama memakai Future Perfect ('will have + V3').

examples.sentence: By the time the quarterly board meeting begins, we will have finalized the audit.
examples.translationId: Pada saat rapat dewan triwulanan dimulai, kami sudah akan merampungkan audit.

examples.sentence: By the time the train arrived, most commuters had already found alternative transport.
examples.translationId: Saat kereta tiba, sebagian besar komuter sudah menemukan transportasi alternatif.

quiz.prompt: Choose the appropriate tense (TOEIC Part 5):
quiz.sentence: By the end of next quarter, the engineering team ______ all legacy servers to the cloud.
quiz.explanationId: Penanda batas masa depan 'By the end of next quarter' berpasangan dengan Future Perfect ('will have migrated').

items.title: Preposition + Relative Pronoun (in which / whereby)
items.formula: Noun + Preposition + which / whom (NEVER 'in that' or 'of that')
items.explanationId: Dalam bahasa akademik formal, preposisi diletakkan sebelum kata ganti penghubung ('in which', 'for which', 'by which', 'to whom'). Kata 'that' tidak pernah boleh dipakai tepat setelah preposisi.
items.keyTip: Memakai 'in which' atau 'whereby' secara tepat membantu menaikkan skor Grammatical Range di IELTS Writing.

examples.sentence: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert sunlight into chemical energy.
examples.translationId: Fotosintesis adalah proses yang melaluinya tumbuhan mengubah cahaya matahari menjadi energi kimia.

examples.sentence: The policy created a framework within which local schools could design curricula.
examples.translationId: Kebijakan itu menciptakan kerangka yang di dalamnya sekolah lokal dapat merancang kurikulum.

quiz.prompt: Select the grammatically accurate academic structure:
quiz.sentence: The committee proposed a funding model ______ rural clinics receive priority equipment.
quiz.explanationId: 'Whereby' (= by which / through which) tepat menghubungkan 'a funding model' dengan klausa lengkap berikutnya.

items.title: Causative Verbs (Have / Make / Let / Get)
items.formula: Have/Make/Let + Person + V1  |  Get + Person + to V1  |  Have/Get + Thing + V3
items.explanationId: Kata kerja kausatif menunjukkan seseorang meminta atau menyebabkan pihak lain melakukan tindakan. Jika objeknya adalah benda yang dikenai tindakan, selalu gunakan bentuk pasif V3.
items.keyTip: Di TOEIC, bentuk pasif 'have + [benda] + V3' (mis. 'have the copier repaired') sangat sering muncul.

examples.sentence: The office manager had the air-conditioning unit inspected before summer.
examples.translationId: Manajer kantor meminta unit pendingin udara diperiksa sebelum musim panas.

examples.sentence: Our supervisor got the IT vendor to upgrade the firewall overnight.
examples.translationId: Pengawas kami meminta vendor TI memperbarui firewall dalam semalam.

quiz.prompt: Complete the workplace sentence:
quiz.sentence: Before printing the annual report, please have the financial tables ______ by the accounting lead.
quiz.explanationId: 'The financial tables' adalah objek pasif (diperiksa), sehingga pola 'have + benda + V3' menuntut 'verified'.

items.title: So...That vs. Such...That
items.formula: so + Adjective/Adverb + that  ||  such + (a/an) + Adjective + Noun + that
items.explanationId: Gunakan 'so' sebelum kata sifat/keterangan yang berdiri sendiri (atau 'so many/much/few/little + noun'). Gunakan 'such' sebelum frasa kata benda (adjective + noun).
items.keyTip: Jika ada artikel 'a/an' sebelum kata sifat + kata benda ('a compelling argument'), hampir pasti menggunakan 'such'.

examples.sentence: The lecture was so engaging that few students noticed the bell had rung.
examples.translationId: Kuliah itu begitu menarik sehingga sedikit mahasiswa yang sadar bel telah berbunyi.

examples.sentence: It was such a compelling proposal that all six investors pledged funding.
examples.translationId: Itu adalah proposal yang begitu meyakinkan hingga keenam investor menjanjikan pendanaan.

quiz.prompt: Find the grammatical error (TOEFL Written Expression):
quiz.sentence: Antarctic winds can blow with [A] so tremendous force [B] that visibility [C] drops to nearly zero [D] within seconds.
quiz.explanationId: 'Tremendous force' adalah frasa Adjective + Noun, sehingga harus memakai 'such tremendous force', bukan 'so tremendous force'.

items.title: Countable vs. Uncountable Quantifiers
items.formula: Countable plural: many, few, fewer, a number of  ||  Uncountable: much, little, less, an amount of
items.explanationId: Kata benda tak terhitung seperti information, equipment, research, furniture, evidence, dan advice tidak memakai akhiran '-s' dan wajib memakai quantifier uncountable (much, little, less, amount of).
items.keyTip: Waspadai kata benda uncountable jebakan di TOEFL/IELTS: research, equipment, evidence, feedback, software, luggage.

examples.sentence: A large amount of laboratory equipment was donated to the regional university.
examples.translationId: Sejumlah besar peralatan laboratorium disumbangkan ke universitas daerah.

examples.sentence: Fewer commuters drove personal cars after the express bus lane opened.
examples.translationId: Lebih sedikit komuter yang mengendarai mobil pribadi setelah jalur bus ekspres dibuka.

quiz.prompt: Choose the incorrect underlined portion:
quiz.sentence: The clinic ordered [A] a great number of [B] diagnostic equipment [C] to shorten patient [D] waiting times.
quiz.explanationId: 'Equipment' adalah uncountable noun sehingga harus menggunakan 'a great amount of' atau 'a large quantity of', bukan 'a great number of'.

items.title: Dangling & Misplaced Participle Modifiers
items.nativeTitle: Matching Modifier Subject with Main Subject
items.formula: [Participle Phrase], [Subject that performs/receives the participle action] + Verb
items.explanationId: Ketika kalimat diawali frasa partisipel ('Having reviewed the data,', 'Built in 1924,'), kata benda tepat setelah koma HARUS merupakan subjek yang melakukan atau mengalami tindakan pada frasa tersebut.
items.keyTip: Tanyakan: 'Siapa yang melakukan tindakan di frasa depan?' Jawabannya harus langsung muncul setelah koma.

examples.sentence: Having analyzed the quarterly survey, the marketing team revised its campaign.
examples.translationId: Setelah menganalisis survei triwulanan, tim pemasaran merevisi kampanyenya.

examples.sentence: Constructed entirely of cedar wood, the historic pavilion survived three earthquakes.
examples.translationId: Dibangun seluruhnya dari kayu cedar, paviliun bersejarah itu bertahan dari tiga gempa.

quiz.prompt: Select the sentence without a dangling modifier:
quiz.sentence: Having completed the clinical trials, ______.
choices: the new vaccine was submitted for approval
approval was requested for the new vaccine
the research team submitted the new vaccine for approval
it was time to submit the new vaccine
quiz.explanationId: Pihak yang menyelesaikan uji klinis ('Having completed') adalah 'the research team', bukan vaksin atau persetujuan.

items.title: Cleft Sentences for Academic Emphasis
items.formula: It is/was + [Focused Element] + that/who + Clause  ||  What + S + V + is/was + [Focus]
items.explanationId: Kalimat belah (cleft sentence) menyoroti satu bagian argumen secara tegas dalam esai IELTS Writing Task 2 maupun presentasi akademik TOEFL iBT.
items.keyTip: Hindari penggunaan berlebihan; gunakan 1–2 kali di paragraf utama esai untuk menunjukkan variasi struktur tingkat tinggi.

examples.sentence: It is consistent daily exposure, rather than rote memorization, that builds fluency.
examples.translationId: Paparan harian yang konsistenlah, bukan hafalan mekanis, yang membangun kefasihan.

examples.sentence: What distinguishes this study from earlier papers is its longitudinal sample size.
examples.translationId: Hal yang membedakan studi ini dari makalah terdahulu adalah ukuran sampel longitudinalnya.

quiz.prompt: Choose the well-formed cleft sentence:
quiz.sentence: ______ makes public transit attractive to commuters is predictable arrival frequency.
quiz.explanationId: Nominal cleft clause di awal kalimat memakai 'What' (= The thing that).

items.title: Conjunctions vs. Conjunctive Adverbs
items.formula: Clause 1; however / therefore / moreover, Clause 2  (NEVER join two clauses with just a comma + however)
items.explanationId: Kata seperti 'however', 'therefore', 'nevertheless', dan 'furthermore' adalah adverbia penghubung, bukan konjungsi koordinatif. Jika menghubungkan dua kalimat lengkap, gunakan titik koma (;) atau titik (.) sebelumnya.
items.keyTip: Kesalahan tanda baca koma + 'however' ('comma splice') langsung menurunkan skor Grammar di IELTS Writing.

examples.sentence: Solar panel prices fell dramatically; consequently, residential adoption doubled.
examples.translationId: Harga panel surya turun drastis; akibatnya, adopsi rumah tangga berlipat ganda.

examples.sentence: The prototype passed durability tests; nevertheless, engineers refined its battery enclosure.
examples.translationId: Purwarupa lulus uji ketahanan; namun demikian, insinyur menyempurnakan pelindung baterainya.

quiz.prompt: Select the logical transition (TOEIC Part 6 / IELTS):
quiz.sentence: The downtown branch closed for renovations; ______, all customer services have shifted to the Westside office.
quiz.explanationId: Setelah titik koma (;) dan diikuti koma (,) untuk menyatakan akibat logis, adverbia penghubung yang tepat adalah 'consequently'.

items.title: Modal Perfects for Deduction & Regret
items.nativeTitle: must have / might have / should have + V3
items.formula: must have V3 (pasti telah) | might/could have V3 (mungkin telah) | should have V3 (seharusnya telah)
items.explanationId: Modal + have + V3 digunakan untuk menarik kesimpulan logis atas peristiwa masa lalu atau mengevaluasi tindakan yang seharusnya dilakukan.
items.keyTip: Dalam TOEFL Listening & Reading, 'must have + V3' selalu menandakan deduksi kuat, bukan kewajiban.

examples.sentence: Ancient mariners must have relied on star charts to cross open ocean currents.
examples.translationId: Pelaut kuno pasti telah mengandalkan peta bintang untuk melintasi arus samudra terbuka.

examples.sentence: The vendor should have notified our logistics desk before altering the delivery route.
examples.translationId: Vendor seharusnya sudah memberi tahu meja logistik kami sebelum mengubah rute pengiriman.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate deduction about a past event:
quiz.sentence: The server logs show zero traffic after midnight; the power outage ______ triggered an automatic shutdown.
quiz.explanationId: Bukti log yang kuat di masa lalu menuntut modal deduksi lampau 'must have' + V3 ('triggered').

items.title: Gerund vs. Infinitive After Specific Verbs
items.nativeTitle: avoid/postpone/consider + V-ing vs. decide/afford/refuse + to V1
items.formula: enjoy/avoid/postpone/recommend/look forward to + V-ing  ||  agree/manage/plan/expect + to V1
items.explanationId: Kata kerja tertentu hanya boleh diikuti gerund (-ing) sedangkan lainnya wajib to-infinitive. Perhatikan pula frasa yang berakhiran preposisi 'to' seperti 'look forward to', 'be accustomed to', dan 'object to' yang wajib diikuti V-ing.
items.keyTip: 'Look forward to + V-ing' adalah salah satu pola paling sering diuji di TOEIC Part 5 & 6.

examples.sentence: We look forward to welcoming your team to our Singapore headquarters next month.
examples.translationId: Kami menantikan kedatangan tim Anda di kantor pusat Singapura kami bulan depan.

examples.sentence: Management decided to postpone launching the loyalty app until Q3.
examples.translationId: Manajemen memutuskan menunda peluncuran aplikasi loyalitas hingga kuartal ketiga.

quiz.prompt: Complete the business email closing (TOEIC Part 5):
quiz.sentence: Our regional partners look forward to ______ the joint sustainability initiative next spring.
quiz.explanationId: Kata 'to' pada 'look forward to' adalah preposisi, sehingga wajib diikuti bentuk gerund ('launching').

items.title: Noun Clauses as Subject or Object
items.formula: [That / What / How + S + V] (Singular Subject) + Singular Main Verb
items.explanationId: Klausa benda (noun clause) dapat berfungsi sebagai subjek kalimat dengan susunan normal (bukan inversi tanya) dan selalu dianggap subjek tunggal.
items.keyTip: Dalam klausa benda tidak langsung ('how the engine works'), JANGAN gunakan inversi ('how does the engine work').

examples.sentence: Whether the wetlands can recover depends on strict watershed protection.
examples.translationId: Apakah lahan basah dapat pulih bergantung pada perlindungan daerah aliran sungai yang ketat.

examples.sentence: Scientists still debate how migratory birds detect subtle shifts in Earth's magnetic field.
examples.translationId: Ilmuwan masih memperdebatkan bagaimana burung migran mendeteksi pergeseran halus medan magnet Bumi.

quiz.prompt: Select the correct noun clause structure (TOEFL ITP):
quiz.sentence: The museum curator explained ______ preserved for more than two millennia.
quiz.explanationId: Klausa benda tidak langsung setelah 'explained' memakai urutan pernyataan: question word + Subject + Verb ('how the bronze scrolls were').

items.title: Academic Hedging Language
items.nativeTitle: tend to / appear to / may indicate / largely
items.formula: Modal (may/might/could) + Verb | Verb (appear/seem/tend to) | Adverb (likely/largely/primarily)
items.explanationId: Tulisan akademik IELTS & TOEFL iBT menghindari klaim absolut yang terlalu menggeneralisasi ('always', 'proves 100%'). Gunakan hedging agar argumen terdengar objektif, ilmiah, dan bernilai Band tinggi.
items.keyTip: Ganti 'Technology destroys social skills' dengan 'Excessive screen time may undermine face-to-face communication skills.'

examples.sentence: Remote work arrangements tend to improve employee retention when paired with clear boundaries.
examples.translationId: Pengaturan kerja jarak jauh cenderung meningkatkan retensi karyawan jika dipadukan dengan batasan yang jelas.

examples.sentence: The survey findings suggest that affordable transit could reduce urban congestion.
examples.translationId: Temuan survei mengindikasikan bahwa transportasi terjangkau berpotensi mengurangi kemacetan kota.

quiz.prompt: Which sentence uses the most appropriate academic hedging for an IELTS Task 2 essay?
choices: Every teenager who plays video games definitely fails school.
Unregulated gaming time may negatively affect adolescents' sleep and study habits.
Video games are always 100% bad for everyone without exception.
Nobody can ever learn anything useful from digital media.
quiz.explanationId: Kalimat kedua memakai hedging akademik ('Unregulated...', 'may negatively affect') yang terukur dan berbasis argumen.

items.title: Comparative Reference (That of / Those of)
items.formula: Singular comparison -> that of  ||  Plural comparison -> those of
items.explanationId: Saat membandingkan dua hal, pastikan objek yang dibandingkan setara (mis. iklim kota A dengan iklim kota B, bukan iklim kota A dengan kota B). Gunakan 'that of' (tunggal) atau 'those of' (jamak).
items.keyTip: Kesalahan klasik TOEFL: membandingkan 'the population of Japan' langsung dengan 'Indonesia' tanpa 'that of'.

examples.sentence: The tensile strength of spider silk surpasses that of high-grade steel.
examples.translationId: Kekuatan tarik sutra laba-laba melampaui kekuatan tarik baja mutu tinggi.

examples.sentence: The operating costs of electric buses are substantially lower than those of diesel fleets.
examples.translationId: Biaya operasional bus listrik jauh lebih rendah dibanding biaya operasional armada diesel.

quiz.prompt: Choose the logical comparison:
quiz.sentence: The average annual rainfall in Bogor is considerably higher than ______ Jakarta.
quiz.explanationId: 'Average annual rainfall' berbentuk tunggal (uncountable), sehingga perbandingan setara memakai 'that of'.

items.title: Prepositions of Time & Deadline (Until vs. By vs. Within)
items.formula: by + point in time (paling lambat) | until + point in time (berlangsung sampai) | within + duration (dalam kurun)
items.explanationId: 'By' menyatakan batas akhir penyelesaian tindakan tunggal; 'until' menyatakan aktivitas yang terus berlangsung hingga titik waktu tertentu; 'within' diikuti rentang durasi (mis. within 48 hours).
items.keyTip: Tanyakan apakah aksinya selesai sekali ('submit by Friday') atau terus berlangsung ('stay open until 8 PM').

examples.sentence: All expense claims must be uploaded to the portal by 5:00 PM on Friday.
examples.translationId: Seluruh klaim biaya harus diunggah ke portal paling lambat Jumat pukul 17.00.

examples.sentence: Customer support responds to priority tickets within two business hours.
examples.translationId: Layanan pelanggan merespons tiket prioritas dalam waktu dua jam kerja.

quiz.prompt: Select the accurate time preposition (TOEIC Part 5):
quiz.sentence: Candidates will receive written notification of the interview outcome ______ ten business days.
quiz.explanationId: 'Ten business days' adalah rentang durasi waktu, sehingga preposisi yang tepat adalah 'within'.
